product_increment.title: Base-bound handoff and review evidence
product_increment.intent: Make one immutable accepted-main portfolio snapshot select the permissible plan, scope, base, branch, and write-root set, then require handoff, review-brief, independent review output, and the Framework pre-push guard to agree on that Git-backed authority and exact changed-surface identity.
acceptance_criteria: Planned work accepts only a full immutable accepted-main SHA supplied after external Program Flow admission, resolves the canonical portfolio blob at that commit, takes plan_ref only from the named source-admissible portfolio entry, validates that exact plan blob, and never trusts a producer-HEAD plan or caller-selected plan path.

Planned leaf handoff derives base, branch, and roots only from the accepted-main lane record; planned integration handoff derives them only from its accepted-main integration record; the unplanned/default route alone resolves merge-base origin/main HEAD.

An optional --base is an equality assertion against the externally derived base, never a selector; HEAD/equal-base and later-intermediate-ancestor narrowing cannot satisfy pre-push, and the authorized base must be a strict ancestor of the pushed head.

Handoff and no-write snapshot retain one versioned binding containing accepted-main SHA, portfolio and plan blob IDs/digests, Product Increment/scope identity, authorized branch/base/write-root digest, head, and content-bound surface digests.

Review-brief revalidates the retained accepted-main portfolio authority and fails closed when its authority, base, roots, head, changed-surface signatures, state fingerprints, or review-scope binding differ from the handoff artifact.

Independent review output names the exact reviewed authority digest, base, head, and review-scope binding, and the parser rejects otherwise complete or fresh review text when any value is missing or mismatched.

The pre-push guard re-reads the retained accepted-main portfolio and registered plan blobs rather than accepting a producer-local plan, caller-selected ancestor, or moving origin/main scope; current-main divergence remains a separate merge-readiness condition.

Program Flow assignment identity, exclusive-lease ownership, and assignment currency remain externally enforced source-admission prerequisites; this capability neither accepts a caller assignment UUID nor claims to verify a live or superseded assignment.

This plan, its governing spec, Product-authorized portfolio registration, and spec index land on accepted main through an independently reviewed planning/control PR that is separate from the future implementation lane; any authority change requires a new planning PR and external Program Flow re-admission.

Handoff and review-brief report destination ref/SHA, observation freshness, merge base, and ahead/behind counts outside the checkpoint binding and explicitly deny that scope agreement establishes destination convergence or merge readiness.

Existing nested-product normalization, special-path handling, additions, deletions, renames, file modes, symlink targets, untracked files, backdated-byte detection, and non-UTF-8 failure behavior do not regress.

The exact assembled correction is routed explicitly through a comprehensive review brief and /framework-pr-review --comprehensive, then passes the normal guard without a bypass before any push; auto-depth focused classification alone cannot satisfy this plan.

No evidence from this increment grants push, merge, release, SRA/CAB, accepted-risk, trusted-reviewer-identity, IX Product acceptance, Nexus adoption, browser/device, live-provider, security, or production-readiness credit.

integration.owner: IX Evidence Scope Integration Branch Manager
integration_checks: Validate the Product Increment plan, portfolio-wide WIP, active-lane owner/root independence, and exact candidate diff before review.

Before source admission, prove the planning spec, executable plan, Product-authorized portfolio registration, and spec index were merged through an independently reviewed planning/control PR from accepted main and remained outside the future implementation lane; external Program Flow then records the resulting accepted-main SHA and exact portfolio/plan scope in its live assignment and exclusive lease.

Run a disposable divergent Git graph proving accepted-main-portfolio-authorized handoff, no-write snapshot, review brief, independent review binding, and pre-push guard all retain the same portfolio/plan/base/root/head/surface identity after origin/main advances.

Reject producer-local plan/spec edits, a caller-selected or unregistered plan, --base HEAD, an equal derived base, a later intermediate ancestor, authority/blob/root drift, branch/scope mismatch, and a caller base that differs from the accepted-main lane or integration base.
Reject valid-looking review documents with missing or mismatched reviewed authority, base, head, or review-scope binding, and prove no bypass establishes the green path.
Preserve the existing nested-product, special-path, content-state, symlink, mode, rename, deletion, untracked, backdated-byte, and non-UTF-8 regression corpus.

The Batch A convergence successor may carry the two approved owner-originated fixture repairs with separate commit provenance, but must preserve their assertions, reconcile the Nexus suite to exactly 36 tests, pass the full docs gate, and receive comprehensive independent review; aggregation does not authorize portfolio registration or the future implementation lane.

Reconcile CLI reference and docs-check examples only after the source lane is immutable, then run changed-only docs-check, generate-check, fast Framework tests, handoff, review-brief --comprehensive, and /framework-pr-review --comprehensive.
Refresh from current origin/main and rerun full candidate evidence before any merge-ready judgment; checkpoint scope binding does not waive destination convergence.

lanes.title: Externally authorized handoff and review-scope binding
lanes.result: Framework handoff, review-brief, review output, and the pre-push guard fail closed unless they refer to one immutable accepted-main portfolio/plan authority, its exact branch/base/roots, a strictly later head, and one content-bound changed-surface state; external Program Flow admission remains separate.
focused_checks: scripts/appfw framework review-brief --authority-commit <externally-selected-accepted-main-SHA> --product-increment AFS-PI-BASE-BOUND-REVIEW-01 --lane AFS-L1-BASE-BOUND-REVIEW --base 1e919fafe783b68cef4abc65f99d585be482b4e7 --head HEAD --comprehensive --json

provides.summary: Versioned immutable base/head/surface agreement across handoff, review, and pre-push enforcement.
